from datetime import date

def lifespan_years_days(birth, death):
    # birth and death are date objects
    years = death.year - birth.year - ((death.month, death.day) < (birth.month, birth.day))
    last_birthday = date(birth.year + years, birth.month, birth.day)
    days = (death - last_birthday).days
    return years, days

# Edward Albee: born March 12, 1928; died September 16, 2016
albee_birth = date(1928, 3, 12)
albee_death = date(2016, 9, 16)
albee_years, albee_days = lifespan_years_days(albee_birth, albee_death)

# J. M. Barrie: born May 9, 1860; died June 19, 1937
barrie_birth = date(1860, 5, 9)
barrie_death = date(1937, 6, 19)
barrie_years, barrie_days = lifespan_years_days(barrie_birth, barrie_death)

(albee_years, albee_days, barrie_years, barrie_days)
```
